reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Water-Fit Sun Serum 50mL*2ea (Twin pack)
reviews.text: This is a recurring purchase for me. I first bought this sunblock based on the recommendation of a sales associate at Olive Young COEX last winter. After finishing another Korean sunblock, I brought it back to Singapore and started using it. In one word: I love this sunblock! It is very lightweight, and the quality is outstanding. There is no scent, and it glides effortlessly onto my skin, absorbing quickly enough for makeup application.
reviews.zh: 呢款防曬我會持續回購。舊年冬天我喺 Olive Young COEX 經銷售員推薦，第一次買咗呢款防曬。用完另一支韓國防曬之後，我帶返新加坡開始用。一句講晒：我好鍾意呢款防曬！佢非常輕薄，質素一流。冇香味，滑順輕鬆推開，吸收得夠快，可以即刻上妝。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Water-Fit Sun Serum 50mL*2ea (Twin pack)
reviews.text:
This sunscreen is overall a great product, especially if you have acne-prone or sensitive skin. It’s super lightweight and hydrating, and it doesn’t clog pores or cause breakouts. I love how it doesn’t leave a white cast at all — it blends in beautifully and feels like nothing on the skin.

The sun protection is also very solid, and it performs well even on sunny days.

However, the main downside for me is that it tends to pill (crumble) on my face — especially if I layer it with other skincare or makeup. You have to be careful with what you use underneath or how much you apply, or you might get little white flakes throughout the day.

Other than that, it’s a fantastic daily sunscreen for sensitive skin with great ingredients and a non-irritating formula.
reviews.zh:
整體嚟講，呢款防曬係好產品，尤其係如果你係容易爆瘡或者敏感肌。佢超級輕身又保濕，而且唔會塞毛孔或者引致爆瘡。我好鍾意佢完全唔會泛白——推開得好靚，貼喺皮膚上好似冇嘢咁。

防曬效果都好實淨，大太陽日子都表現唔錯。

不過，對我嚟講最大嘅缺點係佢容易喺塊面起擦膠碎（甩皮）——尤其係當我再疊其他護膚品或者化妝品。你要小心底層用咩、或者搽幾多，否則成日都會有啲白色碎屑。

撇開呢點，佢係一款非常出色嘅日常防曬，成分溫和、配方不刺激，敏感肌用啱晒。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Water-Fit Sun Serum 50mL*2ea (Twin pack)
reviews.text:
I’ve tried so many sunscreens, but SKIN1004 is hands down the best! It’s super lightweight, non-sticky, and blends like a dream. What I love most is how perfectly it sits under foundation, no pilling, no white cast, just smooth, flawless skin. 

If you’re looking for an everyday SPF that feels amazing and actually works, this is the one. 
Highly recommend!
reviews.zh:
我用過咁多防曬，SKIN1004 絕對係最好嗰支！佢超級輕身，唔黏笠，推開好似發夢咁順。我最鍾意嘅係佢喺粉底底下貼得剛剛好，唔會起擦膠碎、唔會泛白，只有滑溜無瑕嘅皮膚。

如果你想搵一支用得舒服又真係 work 嘅日常防曬，就係呢支。
高度推薦！

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Water-Fit Sun Serum 50mL*2ea (Twin pack)
reviews.text: One of the best sunscreens I have ever used. This sunscreen is non-sticky and quickly absorbs into the skin, making it perfect for daily use. It provides excellent sun protection without leaving any greasy residue. The lightweight formula feels comfortable on the skin, and the centella asiatica extract helps to soothe and hydrate. I highly recommend this sunscreen to anyone looking for effective and comfortable sun protection.
reviews.zh: 我用過嘅防曬入面，最好嘅之一。呢款防曬唔黏笠，吸收得快，非常適合日常使用。佢提供出色嘅防曬保護，又唔會留低油笠笠嘅感覺。質地輕身，貼喺皮膚上好舒服，仲有積雪草萃取幫助舒緩同保濕。任何想搵高效又舒服嘅防曬嘅人，我都高度推薦呢款。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Water-Fit Sun Serum 50mL*2ea (Twin pack)
reviews.text:
AMAZING sun cream! It is so light weight and non greasy. It also does NOT have that terrible sunscreen smell either. I honestly like it better than the Beauty of Joseon sun cream because the Skin1004 one is lighter and has a thinner texture. It also seems to absorb faster. I bought 4 of these so I can give it to my boyfriend and his mom and have a backup. 

I have dry skin so this one works well for me but I heard that if you have oily skin, the airy-fit sun cream light is better. I haven’t tried it yet but I heard that it takes longer to rub in BUT has a more matte finish.
reviews.zh:
超讚嘅防曬霜！佢好輕身又唔油笠。而且完全冇嗰種難聞嘅防曬味。講真我鍾意佢多過 Beauty of Joseon 嘅防曬霜，因為 Skin1004 嗰支更輕更薄，仲好似吸收得更快。我買咗 4 支，可以分畀男朋友同佢媽媽，自己都有後備。

我係乾性肌，呢支對我好啱，但我聽講如果係油性肌，airy-fit sun cream light 會更加好。我未試過，但聽講嗰支要耐啲先推得開，不過妝效會更加霧面。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Water-Fit Sun Serum 50mL*2ea (Twin pack)
reviews.text: Unfortunately this didn’t not work for me, because I absolutely love the finish and texture. I got this because everyone loves to talk about the no white cast and honestly, thats a lie. I’m mexican and I don’t even have a deeper skin-tone i’m like a light tan. probably would be offensive to say I have brown skin lol. Anyways, it always leaves a white case especially in the facial hair! Wanted to love it bc it doesnt leave you overly shiny or anything and feels so good on skin.
reviews.zh: 可惜呢支對我嚟講唔 work，雖然我好鍾意佢嘅妝效同質地。我買佢係因為個個都講到唔會泛白，但講真係假嘅。我係墨西哥人，我膚色都唔算深，大概係淺古銅色。話自己有啡色皮膚可能會冒犯到人 lol。無論點，佢永遠都會留低白色痕跡，尤其係喺面毛上面！本來想鍾意佢嘅，因為佢唔會令你太過光亮，貼喺皮膚上都幾舒服。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Water-Fit Sun Serum 50mL*2ea (Twin pack)
reviews.text: This sunscreen is one of the best I’ve ever tried! So lightweight, goes on like moisturizer and leaves zero white cast!! It also sits really well under makeup and doesn’t peel or feel sticky or overwhelming in the skin. I’m the type to really dislike oily or really heavy products, so this was such a great buy! I have sensitive to oily/combo skin and I really recommend this product!
reviews.zh: 呢款防曬係我用過嘅最好之一！好輕身，搽落好似保濕霜，完全唔泛白！！佢喺妝底下都好貼服，唔會甩皮、唔會黏笠、唔會有焫促感。我係嗰種真係好怕油笠或者厚重產品嘅人，所以呢支真係買對咗！敏感肌到油性／混合肌都啱用，我真係推薦呢款產品！

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Water-Fit Sun Serum 50mL
reviews.text: Despite all the rave reviews I’ve been hearing from people I was surprised I didn’t actually love this sunscreen. It clung to my dry spots and started pilling not even 10 minutes after I put it on. The texture of this sun cream is also thicker than I thought it would be. Doesn’t really blend in all that well either as it gave me a slight whitecast. Don’t really see the hype. There’s other sunscreens I’ve tried that are better. I just use this for my neck and body now.
reviews.zh: 雖然聽咗咁多人嘅好評，但我竟然冇真正愛上呢款防曬。佢黐住我嘅乾紋位，搽完唔夠 10 分鐘就開始起擦膠碎。呢款防曬霜嘅質地都比我預期中厚，唔算好推得開，而且會輕微泛白。睇唔到點解咁紅。我試過其他防曬更加好。而家我只係用佢嚟搽頸同身。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
